text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume were to climb a mountain as part of an academy event aimed at improving stamina.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer,
for coming along as staff!
choice_data_list: I'll be on standby at the campsite, though.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even so! Participation was optional after all.
I'm going to give it everything I've got today too~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Let's all do our best on the mountain hike!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, the group assignments are random, right?
To think I'd end up with Vodka here too...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Training deep in the mountains
sounds so very witch-like, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(That's all the group members... A mixed-grade vertical group.
Out of everyone here, I'm the oldest!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: All right, leave the directions to me! I've got the map completely memorized!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Wait, the way back is blocked!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
" 'Road closed due to rockfall'...?
No way, what do I do...? There's no cell service out here either, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
Let's take the long way home!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wait!
Are you okay?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Leave the directions to me!
I've memorized the whole route!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It's pretty dangerous if I don't watch my step...
Wait, but if I only look down, I'll bump my head..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's really... dark out...
We have a light, but it's way too unreliable...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Here, a plastic bottle filled with water!
Try holding it in front of the light.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wow!
It's gotten quite a bit brighter...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I wonder if this will brighten the mood
even a little bit? Just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hauu... I'm positively starving~.
I wonder if it's dinner time
at the camp right about now...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, drink Tsuyoshi's Special Health Drink!
It has a unique smell, but it's super nutritious!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I prepared plenty,
so there's quite a lot left over~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that that mysterious drink you were having at lunch!?
...U-Umm..., alright, just one sip then...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Delicious!
What is this surging power?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "It's got extracts from oysters and scallops in it, which are amazingly good for recovery from fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo waaaay!!
I'm already bored! I don't wanna walk anymore~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep-chan, Sweep-chan!
I found a branch that looks like it'd make an amazing magic wand!
Do you wanna go check it out together!?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...A cane? ...Hmm?
Jeez... you're helpless, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi and the others were taking longer than expected,
and just as I was wondering if I should go look for them—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry!
I'm back now!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Phew~ We somehow made it safely to the campsite!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes~! Because the road was closed, I had to take a detour...
choice_data_list: That must have made you anxious...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Worried? Nah, not at all!
Felt more like going on a little adventure, if ya ask me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san took the lead for us!
She was so dependable!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Along the way, everyone shared
their boundless energy with me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, wasn't I at least a little helpful? We found a good walking stick, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad!
I'm happy everyone feels that way.
choice_data_list: You really worked hard, didn't you?
It's the hero and her party.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad!
I'm happy everyone feels that way.
choice_data_list: You really worked hard, didn't you?
It's the hero and her party.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing you say that
makes me feel pretty proud of myself~!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well, but getting into trouble or taking detours
is practically a daily routine for me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm super happy that knowledge like that could be helpful to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But still, the reason we made it back safely
is because every single one of us did our best!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "So, let's just say everyone in this party is a hero!"
